column1: # Curated inline comments for FT710_IFDSP, Cortex-M33 program (T23i), applied by tools/ghidra/CommentCode.java.
# address<TAB>comment (one short line)<TAB>evidence: [fact: <address or doc>] or [inference] / [inference: <reason>]
# Taken from docs/code/ifdsp/; find the address of a C line with tools/ghidra/DecompLines.java. No [guess] rows.

column2: CR/LF (mask 0x2401): end of line, tokenize and run
Split at ctype whitespace: up to 4 tokens of 15 chars
Machine mode: the rest of argv[0] must be hex
7-char frame: checksum of the first 5 chars
Pace the dump to the UART
r: read reply "r" + value + sum, no CR
i DB00 / DB01: machine or interactive mode
11-char w frame with a good checksum, else ?
w: write the register, reply ACK 0x06
Interactive: look argv[0] up in table 0x8795C
Unknown command or too many tokens: ?
